purpose: Pins the published Agent Ready CLI and local MCP contract at the bound package release, so AlienIntent's adapters (execution_coordination/adapters/agent_ready_producer.py) are checked against it rather than restating it (C#/contracts/4/adapters_note, DV-5). Public documentation only; no Agent Ready private module, rubric or schema is copied.

bound_release.version_source: installed-distribution metadata of the configured executable (composition/readiness.py resolve_binding)
bound_release.contract_version_limitation: sanookdu/agent-ready#1: v0.1 results carry no product or schema version identifier; the CLI exposes no --version; MCP initialize.serverInfo.version reports the MCP SDK version (observed 1.29.1), recorded as sdk_version and never as product_version

exit_status.0: successful assessment, any of READY, CLARIFY, SPLIT, HOLD

mcp.text: actual text, never a path; 1..100000 characters
mcp.success: structuredContent holds the assessment object and a JSON text content block repeats it
mcp.exit_status: none; an MCP tool result has no process exit status of its own

limits_honoured_by: the product: AlienIntent adapters submit text unmodified and never truncate
